text:
vincent: Tiny challenge: you have an evening of bad weather and zero streaming bandwidth. Recommend one comfort movie, one guilty-pleasure snack, and one album (physical or downloaded).
aya: Movie: Amelie. Snack: microwave popcorn + chili flakes. Album: Fleet Foxes 1. cozy and slightly odd.
noah: Movie: Moonrise Kingdom. Snack: boxed macaroni and cheese. Album: The Postal Service 1. nostalgic and tightly wound.
maria: Movie: The Iron Giant (yes it's for kids). Snack: dark chocolate-covered pretzels. Album: Nina Simone 1. calm and full of feeling.
vincent: @maria the Iron Giant tears every time, confirmed. :sob:
ops-bot: Heads-up: office power check at 20:00 tonight, might be a good time to test offline playlists. :wrench:
aya: Quick poll: react :clapper: for the movie, :popcorn: for the snack, :musical_note: for the album pick you’d steal.
noah: If bandwidth is truly nil bring a book instead: my pick would be The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle.
maria: Also, pro tip: download two albums. one for mood, one for weird loopable ambient.
vincent: Putting together a tiny bad-weather mixtape: https://tinyurl.com/bad-weather-mix (45 mins)
aya: Screenshotting these picks for future rainy-night survival kit. :camera_with_flash:
noah: If anyone wants a printable checklist for the snack + movie + album combo I can slap one together tomorrow.
maria: yes please, make it pretty so I can tape it on my pantry door. :sparkles:
